name: Flexdeal, SIMFE, S.A.
note: Portuguese listed investment company (it publishes market announcements and investor disclosures on flexdeal.pt), led by Alberto Amaral, who also chairs the board of Raize (Jornal Económico, 20 Jan 2026). Held 49.21% of the share capital and voting rights of Raize - Instituição de Pagamentos in January 2026 (Jornal Económico, 20 Jan 2026; Jornal PT50, 21 Jan 2026) and informed the Bank of Portugal of an intention to raise that stake to up to 51%.
